description: This file defines models and default functions for mobile action editors in a widget configuration context, including templates for processing images, QR codes, location, launch results, and error handling, with functions to generate default implementations based on action types.

methods.name: getDefaultProcessImageFunction
methods.description: Returns a default image processing function template customized for the specified mobile action type.

methods.name: getDefaultProcessLaunchResultFunction
methods.description: Returns a default launch result processing function template customized for the specified mobile action type.

methods.name: getDefaultProcessQrCodeFunction
methods.description: Provides the default QR code processing function template.

methods.name: getDefaultProcessLocationFunction
methods.description: Provides the default location processing function template.

methods.name: getDefaultProvisionSuccessFunction
methods.description: Provides the default device provision success handler function.

methods.name: getDefaultGetLocationFunction
methods.description: Provides the default function to get location data.

methods.name: getDefaultGetPhoneNumberFunction
methods.description: Provides the default function to get phone number.

methods.name: getDefaultHandleEmptyResultFunction
methods.description: Returns a default handler for empty/canceled results based on action type.

methods.name: getDefaultHandleErrorFunction
methods.description: Returns a default error handler for failed mobile actions based on action type.

methods.name: getDefaultHandleNonMobileFallBackFunction
methods.description: Provides a fallback function for non-mobile environments.
